name: Prodigies
summary: This unusual take on a classic romantic comedy explores the universal complexities of long-term relationships through the lens of a very unique couple. Didi and Ren are two ex-child prodigies who have been together since they were children. Now in their early 30s, they are starting to question whether their very ordinary existence is living up to the extraordinary promise of their childhood. Inevitably, they find themselves asking the same questions of their relationship. As individual hopes and needs feed into and conflict with their shared lives, the series challenges the fallacy at the heart of romantic storytelling - that the tale is over when the heroes get together. In life, surely, that is just the beginning?

name: The News on Merit TV: Morning Edition
summary: Fanchon Stinger and Joe Gumm bring you the latest news from across the US and around the world.

name: The Sound and the Fury
summary:
The Sound and The Fury takes us closer than ever before to rediscover the war for what it truly is: the most significant event of the contemporary world.

Navigating events and continents, each episode alternates between a global approach and close-up incursions into the lives of men and women caught in the hell of World War II. From the Japanese invasion of Manchuria to the siege of Stalingrad, from the attack on Pearl Harbor to the battle of El Alamein, the series narrates World War II on a "planet level" to place it on a truly global scale.

name: History Crush
summary:
We all have a History Crush. Lord Byron was a stone-cold smash. Cleopatra was one of history's most famous hotties. But, have we ever really stopped to consider if our history crushes are suitable? Defendable even? Well, panic over because love-hungry historian Katie Kennedy has assembled a team of experts to answer the big questions we've all been too afraid to ask.

In each episode of History Crush, Katie, otherwise known as The History Gossip, and an expert historian rummage through the drawers of some of the titans of history, sniffing out the stuff that wouldn't make their dating profile before passing judgement on whether they're a crush or a burn. In this series Lord Byron, Charles II, Cleopatra, Elizabeth I, Marie Antoinette, Napoleon, Charles Dickens and Henry VIII are all reviewed to see if, despite some questionable life choices, it's still ok to crush on them. This may be a bit spicier than your average history show.

name: The Borderers
summary: Premiering on New Year's Eve, BBC's first colour action-adventure series, The Borderers, plunges into the violent and feud-ridden 16th-century Anglo-Scottish border. Here, cattle-rustling and simmering tensions ignite into brutal conflict, challenging figures like Ker of Cessford, Warden of the Scottish Middle March, to maintain order amongst clans more loyal to their own kin than the Crown.

name: Get a Clue
summary: A fast-paced, high energy clue game in which two teams compete to see who can successfully guess the most answer words before time runs out.

name: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
summary: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders is a gripping three-part docuseries that revisits a chilling crime that shattered the nation's trust in the safety of everyday brands. Chicago, 1982: at least seven people die after ingesting cyanide-laced Tylenol capsules, sparking nationwide panic and one of the largest criminal investigations in U.S. history. Is there one mastermind behind these horrific deaths, or is that simply a convenient scapegoat in a darker conspiracy and potential cover-up? The series reopens the case that turned the world's best-selling drug into a terrifying symbol—and changed forever how we view the products in our own medicine cabinets.

name: Journeys into the Outside with Jarvis Cocker
summary: Three programmes in which pop star Jarvis Cocker looks at extraordinary buildings made by ordinary people.

name: Ik val niet, ik dans
summary: True-life based drama series about the life story of Emma who was confronted with cancer at a young age and has since been determined to get the most out of life.

name: Love Thy Nader
summary: This bold docuseries follows the unapologetic - and often hilarious - lives of the Nader sisters: Brooks, Mary Holland, Grace Ann and Sarah Jane. Raised in the Louisiana bayou, they've traded small-town roots for high fashion, high drama, and the hustle of New York City.

Each episode of 12 12 12 unfolds across three timelines of a heist: the 12 months of planning, the 12 hours of the heist and the 12 days following it. The series follows a disgraced FBI agent and an American career criminal as they play a zero-sum game of cat and mouse across Europe. At the center of it all is the daring, epic raid on a bank vault deep beneath the streets of Zurich.

name: American Hostage
summary: The first 8-episode installment of this anthology series is set in the 1970s. The psychological thriller tells the harrowing true story of Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter who is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

name: House Hunters Australia
summary:
In the first ever season of House Hunters Australia, Aussie buyers dive headfirst into the chaos of finding their dream home and you get to come along for the ride.

Narrated by The Project's Georgie Tunny, the stakes are high as buyers tour three homes, each offering a unique mix of pros, cons, and unexpected decisions. Will they fall for the fixer-upper full of potential, the sleek modern gem, or the house they didn't see coming?

Whether it's debating modern kitchens versus heritage charm, clashing over pools and veggie patches, or weighing city life against coastal escapes, each episode is packed with big personalities and even bigger decisions.

With stunning Australian backdrops, plenty of laughs, and the occasional wild card property that could change everything, every episode delivers the thrill of the hunt and the satisfaction of the final choice. Packed with relatable moments, fiery opinions, and a healthy dose of Aussie humour, play along and guess which home will win their hearts (and wallets).

name: Terapie
summary: The THERAPY series is unique for its psychological depth, well developed characters and the setting, mostly concentrated in one area. Most of the story takes place in the consulting room of psychologist Marek Posta (Karel Roden) who attends to several patients with a variety of traumas during the weekdays. Every Monday the psychologist receives a saucy Sandra (Tatiana Pauhofová) who confesses in the opening episode that she is in love with Marek.

name: Fated Master and Disciple
summary: Orphan girl A Dai falls for the immortal Xiao Yihan of the righteous Xianling Sect and becomes his disciple. Determined to graduate successfully, A Dai works hard to master all kinds of immortal techniques, while constantly outsmarting and sparring with her teacher and eventually grows into a powerhouse of the sect. However they turns against each other, chasing each other across a thousand miles and locked in a passionate cycle of love and rivalry!

name: The Punishment
summary: It tells the story of police officer Qin Feng as he engages in a battle of wits and will with criminal forces. Set against the backdrop of Hanzhou's rapid development, the script draws on a series of serious criminal cases to portray the complex relationships between the police, their families, and powerful interest groups. The main narrative centers on Qin Feng and Liu Tianye, two sworn brothers with no blood ties, exploring the depths of human nature and moral conflict. With a fast-paced plot and constant suspense, the story highlights the struggle between good and evil and the enduring power of faith in the rule of law.

name: The Weeknight
summary: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.

name: Crash Course Religions
summary: John Green will explore the history and culture of religions and how they offer frameworks for making sense of our lives, while being incredibly slippery things to pin down. We'll discover how we define, debate, and contest what religion means, whether we're personally religious or not.

name: Mechanical Marie
summary: Former martial arts legend Marie has accepted a new job as a "mechanical maid"… except she's 100% human, and Arthur, her new boss, despises humans. Luckily, Marie's naturally expressionless face helps her keep up the robot act while secretly protecting Arthur from constant assassination attempts. But when Arthur falls in love with his "perfect" maid, things quickly spiral out of control!

name: Crime Scene Investigators
summary: Crime Scene Investigators offers a fresh take on the true-crime docudrama, weaving forensic evidence into a single visual frame—a puzzle detectives must piece together to catch the killer. From blood spatter and shell casings to bio-markers and digital fingerprints, every fragment adds to the intricate array of evidence that ultimately exposes a murderer at large.

name: The Briefing with Jen Psaki
summary: Based in Washington, D.C., The Briefing with Jen Psaki will pull from Psaki's decades-long experiences on campaign buses, in the Oval Office, at the State Department, and in the briefing room to dissect the most important stories of the day. Every day the show will aim to help viewers better understand the happenings in Washington and around the country, how it impacts their communities, and what leaders are doing to stand up for the people they represent.

name: The Age of Innocence
summary: Based on Wharton's novel of forbidden love in 19th-century New York, The Age of Innocence follows a passionate and heartrending will they, won't they love triangle while exploring themes of freedom, duty, identity, and love in all its forms. The new take promises to be true to Wharton's novel but will speak to a new generation as it traverses the ballrooms and bedrooms of its young characters, asking what is love — and what is lust. And should we ultimately be driven by our heads, or by our hearts?

name: All Rise for Julian Clary
summary: All Rise for Julian Clary as he holds court, presiding over the grievances of the public and acting as judge and jury.

name: Unaccustomed Earth
summary: Inspired by the internationally beloved bestseller of the same name, Unaccustomed Earth is an epic, soapy drama about a tight-knit immigrant community navigating love, desire, and belonging. When a star-crossed romance between a devoted wife and her long-lost love comes to light, a scandalous affair is born and new battle lines are drawn in the elite, insular Indian American community of Cambridge, Massachusetts. Rich with passion and unforgettable characters, Unaccustomed Earth is an intimate, nuanced look inside a tight-knit community.

name: Sneaky Links: Dating After Dark
summary: Six sexy singles check into a motel in pursuit of true love, only to discover their longtime booty calls, or "sneaky links," are there as well. Facing desires old and new, and many hard truths, guests must decide whether to strengthen their sneaky link or explore new connections. Will they stay sneaky, or is love worth "checking out"?

name: Miss Governor
summary: As she tries to shine in politics, Mississippi's first Black lieutenant governor must manage her zany family and overcome a boss who's stuck in the past.

name: Murderous Encounter
summary: The story centers around two journalists who meet at the scene of a brutal serial murder case in Tokyo. The man is a famous freelance writer for a weekly magazine, while the woman is a director for a television information program. As they pursue the same case, the two become attracted to each other, but suspicions about the man begin to emerge one after another.

name: Generationer
summary: A mummified infant's body is discovered during a renovation in a Frederiksberg apartment. Martha, an 87-year-old resident, unexpectedly confesses to the crime, triggering a journey into family secrets long buried. Crime and mystery intertwines as the complex tale of a family across multiple generations is unfolded. Told through the lens of a crime plot infused with subtle mysterious elements, exploring themes of guilt, shame, and transformation.

name: Shark: The Storm
summary: The story of Cha Woo Sol, a victim of school violence for three years, who stabbed the perpetrator in the eye, becoming a criminal from a bullying victim and a world mixed martial arts champion.

name: May All Your Wishes Come True
The Long Way Home
summary: Through a raid on a human trafficking ring, Detective Gu Xinhe and Forensic Artist Qi Chu join Zhao Shi's anti-trafficking task force. As they untangle a web of cold cases, the team zeroes in on the notorious "Auntie Gui" syndicate. Qi Chu goes undercover at great personal risk, leading to the takedown of the long-operating criminal network and exposing Auntie Gui's horrifying scheme of "using trafficking to fund more trafficking.

name: The Corner of the World is Dinner
summary: Three female roommates with entirely different careers, personalities, and schedules share a home. Despite their differences, they share one ritual. No matter what conflicts or problems they face in life, love, or work, they always come together as night falls to cook and share a proper meal. For them, the day's troubles always seem to resolve themselves after dinner.

name: A Promise to You
summary: The demon princess Zhao Yue, who had originally only set revenge as her goal, found herself entangled in an unexpected scandal on her wedding day. The river god Ruo Xiao crashed the ceremony, bringing along a child. Before anyone could react, Zhao Yue's fiancé, the demon lord, flew into a rage over being "cuckolded," unleashing a thunderstorm and throwing knives at his bride. Zhao Yue was utterly baffled, unable to understand why the ancient god would barge into her wedding with a child, and she firmly denied any connection to either Ruo Xiao or the child. However, wary of the complications involving a child, she quickly assessed the situation and decided to "flee with the child" for now. During the escape, memories of a long-sealed past slowly resurfaced. Beneath the absurd chaos lay a deep and enduring love that had remained unresolved for a hundred years. It turns out that years ago, by the cold waters of Qingying Pool, the ancient god Ruo Xiao, moved by compassion, had fallen for a wounded demon woman who had descended from the sky. However, he gave his body and mind to the wrong person and ended up raising a child alone for five hundred years, waiting for his wife to return. As the truth comes to light and their love reignites, they must face an impossible choice. On one side, the love is too deep to suppress, and on the other side, the gods and demons are on different paths. How will they decide their fate?

name: 90 Day: Hunt for Love
summary: Step into a world where sparks fly and hearts race as everyone is introduced at a masquerade ball to connect, flirt, and find romance. But it's not just about finding someone new—some of these singles have a history! Will old flames reignite? As jealousy bubbles up faster than the hot tub jets during a hot-tub-speed-dating session, tensions rise, and feelings get messy. From flirty first impressions to late-night confessions, expect shocking hook-ups and unexpected pairings. The journey transforms into a thrilling adventure in chemistry and connection, filled with romantic curveballs and twists for each of the singles.

nextepisode.name: The Girl Who Got the Ick

name: Off the Grid with Colin and Manu
summary: MKR favourites Manu Feildel and Colin Fassnidge are going Off The Grid on a road trip around Aotearoa to discover local places, local faces, and local produce - with a generous dose of banter for good measure!

name: Deep Look
summary: Deep Look explores the unseen at the very edge of our visible world. Get a new perspective on our place in the universe and meet extraordinary new friends. Explore big scientific mysteries by going incredibly small.

name: Hunt for Love: Between the Sheets
summary: This unfiltered, one-hour after-show dives deeper into each week's episodes. Cast members from this season will provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their heated romances in Tulum. Through never-before-seen footage, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down, both on and off camera, in paradise.

name: Battle of the Irish Dancers
summary: Hot on the heels of the Irish Dancing World Championships in Dublin this month, Sky is today announcing a brand-new series charting the drama and devotion of Ireland's most loved artform. New Sky Original, Battle of the Irish Dancers, coming later this year, follows a cast of dedicated dancers and their teachers on the road to the Championships, spotlighting a dance form which requires the strength, endurance and agility of an Olympian.

name: Yukon Rescue
summary: From Whitehorse to the remote towns at the edge of the Arctic, the Yukon is one of the most challenging places on Earth to live... let alone be a first responder. But someone has to do the job. Yukon Rescue is a heart-pounding doc series about the Yukoners who answer the call to keep people safe in the rugged Canadian North. Featuring breaking cases from wildfire to search and rescue, animal services to highways, these front line workers go toe-to-toe with Mother Nature - battling lethal temperatures, vast distances, scarce supplies, and an unforgiving landscape to get the job done.

name: De la cabeza
summary: An absurdist comedy show. Oiginal for its time, it represented a renewal of comedy on Argentine television.

name: The Innes Book of Records
summary:
No facts, no figures, no records broken. 

In this new musical diversion, the sounds of today echo back nostalgically from a loophole in time. The programme features the words, music and performance of Neil Innes with special contributions from guest stars.

name: Detectives These Days Are Crazy!
summary: Once a legendary detective, Nagumo Keiichiro now stumbles through middle age baffled by smartphones and modern life. His quiet decline gets disrupted when Mashiro, a bold high school girl, bursts into his office demanding to become his apprentice. Though he's rusty and set in his ways, her relentless enthusiasm drags him back into detective work. Now the gap-bridging detective duo is on the case!

previousepisode.name: Nakumo, the Cloak／Produced by Nakumo Detective Agency／Nakumo Detective Agency, Dissolved

name: Loving the Lie
summary: Genius traditional Chinese painter Xin Yi returns to her picturesque hometown with a hidden agenda. She carefully lays out a plan to become the hired artist of renowned collector Guan Shanhai. But her true motive is to uncover the truth behind a horrific incident from over a decade ago - her father was lured into a counterfeit art factory and died tragically, while her younger sister Nong was brutally abused and left mentally shattered. Using herself as bait, Xin Yi is determined to expose the mastermind behind the tragedy. At a critical moment, Guan Shanhai's son, Guan Huai, unexpectedly offers her a helping hand—hoping to use her in his own power struggle to usurp control from his father. With hidden intentions on both sides, the two begin a perilous collaboration, stirring up a storm in what once was a quiet and peaceful town…

name: Yuezhou Phantom Tales
summary: In the first year of the Zaichu era, Tang Dynasty, a bizarre suicide resembling a ghost-summoning ritual shocks Yuezhou's West District. Investigating the case, Si Wen, the young magistrate of Yue Prefecture, discovers the victim is none other than Liu Zhaodi, a once-renowned courtesan he once loved deeply. But as the seventh day of her death arrives, abandoned infants rise as vengeful mountain spirits, unraveling a meticulously planned retribution...

name: The Art Assignment
summary: The Art Assignment is an educational video series hosted by curator Sarah Urist Green. We explore art and art history through the lens of things happening today.

previousepisode.name: Make a Book with Meat (or other atypical materials) ft. Ben Denzer

name: Two Cents
summary: Two Cents is an educational show about personal finance.

previousepisode.name: Are You Ready for a Recession?

name: Mickey
summary: The Gradys, a Midwestern family, inherit a bayfront California hotel. Mickey Rooney stars as Mickey Grady, a lifelong landlocked Nebraskan who sees the Pacific Ocean for the first time when he and his family drive out to look over the bay-front hotel he inherited. Sammee Tong plays the hotel manager who was included in the inheritance. Emmaline Henry plays Mickey's wife; real-life son Tim Rooney and Brian Nash, the sons.

name: Origin of Everything
summary: Every aspect of our daily reality, whether its the words we use, the pop culture we love, the technology that get us through the day, or even the identities we give ourselves, emerge from thousands of intersecting histories. And on this show, we're going to explore them ALL! . . . Okay, maybe not ALL, but you get the idea.

name: Dead and Buried
summary: What is our society's relationship to death? Many are disconnected from its reality and afraid to even think of it or discuss it. How did we get here, and are there different ways to connect to this part of life that we all must face for ourselves and our loved ones? How do we reclaim death from the industries and processes that have distanced us from it?

name: Why Am I Like This?
summary: Being a human can be weird. Even when everything is "normal" (whatever that means), you might not always get what your body is doing…or why. Dr. Tina Lasisi, full-time biological anthropologist and part-time human, is here to help you make sense of how and why our bodies do what they do.

previousepisode.name: Why Does My Voice Sound Like This?

name: BrainCraft
summary: Vanessa Hill talks about psychology, neuroscience, and why we act the way we do. Neuroscience has never been so animated.

previousepisode.name: Why your brain feels different at 11pm

name: Roots of Resistance
summary: Have you ever looked around and wondered how society transformed into what it is today? Felecia For the Win is here to shed some light on it all. On Roots of Resistance we'll take a deep dive into various social movements, and into the individuals who helped create them, that have shaped how we exist today.

previousepisode.name: The Disturbing History of America's Highways

name: Climbing in Heels
summary: A fictional tale following the rise of five ambitious secretaries navigating the glitzy world of 1980s Hollywood while offering a glimpse into the boys-will-be-boys club and the women who wanted a seat at a table where they were expected to serve. It's a juicy story of friendship, betrayal, survival and ambition. It's also a cautionary tale about how some of those women became very much like the monsters they worked for.

name: Кредит доверия
summary: After the tragic death of her parents, Mila inherits a huge debt. A chance to save herself is a dance competition with a million-dollar prize. But there is little time to prepare: collectors demand immediate payment. Will Mila manage to win and avoid the debt hole?

name: Yabusaka de wa Gozaimasen
summary: The protagonist, Fushigi Mai, who works at the silent cafe "Morning Glory," and her colleague at the cafe, Kamishita Ryo, a younger man who has a close relationship with people, one day enter into a relationship where they "observe" each other. While working together, Mai becomes interested in Ryo, but it's not easy because she has a trauma from her first love and is in a complicated relationship... Meanwhile, Ryo is also interested in Mai, and behind his cool appearance, his feelings for Mai overflow... Will the two be able to open the door to each other's hearts?

name: Under His Command
summary: John Campbell has spent months investigating Destiny Church, encountering fear from insiders like he's never seen before—what is Brian Tamaki doing, and why does it terrify them?

name: La Gata
summary: Esmeralda, whom everybody calls "The Stray Cat", grew up in a suburban slum under miserable conditions; ever since she was a little girl she has lived with Doña Rita, who exploits her by sending her out on the streets to beg or sell candies in order to "earn her food and bed". As a child, she became friends with Pablo, a wealthy child who cares for her and tries to help her behind his mother´s back, Lorenza, who looks down on "The Stray Cat" due to her social prejudices which make her reject poor, uneducated people. Esmeralda has turned into a beautiful woman over time and although she is still very poor, she has managed to always look pretty in front of Pablo. They have grown together, but Pablo has problems with noticing that he feels more than just affection for her.

name: Fugitivos
summary: Julian is an engineer who overnight destroys his life, his marriage, and his work, as he is blamed for a murder he did not commit. After being sentenced to 26 years in prison, he decides to run away to find the only witness who knows the real culprit.

name: Solo per passione - Letizia Battaglia fotografa
summary: In the bigoted and retrograde Palermo of the immediate post-war period, Letizia is a curious and rebellious girl who at sixteen decides to get married hoping to have more freedom but instead finds herself trapped in a marriage strictly disciplined by patriarchal rules. Following a nervous breakdown, she will be admitted to a Swiss clinic and undergo psychiatric treatment. Back in Palermo, with her marriage in full crisis and in a state of perennial emotional fragility, Letizia decides to face her malaise with psychoanalysis, continuing to feel trapped in a reality that she cannot accept.

name: Fred & Rose West: A British Horror Story
summary: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.

name: Hotellet
summary: 11 celebrity couples are each given a suitcase. One contains half a million, another sends you home. Welcome to Hotellet!

name: Oljefondet - på innsiden
summary: Nicolai Tangen and his team's job is to make our savings grow. How do they work to succeed in that?

name: Любовь – не шоу-бизнес
summary: This is the story of Zhenya, a young woman who, having come to Moscow from the provinces and begun working with Russian stars, becomes familiar with the customs and traditions of show business. Despite all her adventures, she remains true to herself, and that's precisely why she achieves recognition and finds love.

name: Drømmen om Alaska
summary: Sisters Ylva-li and Ronja grew up in the dog farm and train dog sleds together. The goal is to become the first Norwegian juniors to participate in the Iditarod.

name: Ключі від правди
summary: "Keys to the Truth" is a gripping detective series where every secret hides a deep personal drama. Valeria, a seasoned investigator, is forced to leave the service after the tragic death of her brother, who was wrongly accused of a crime. Losing faith in the system, she launches her own investigation, which leads her to a luxurious hotel hiding dark intrigues, lies, and crimes behind its elegant walls. The path to truth proves to be more dangerous than she ever expected. She's not just searching for the culprit — she's fighting for the truth that could change everything.

name: It's Lit!
summary: It's Lit! is a series of smart, funny video essays about our favorite books and why we love to read. Hosted by Lindsay Ellis and Princess Weekes, the series delves into topics like the evolution of YA, how science fiction mirrors our own anxieties, and why the book is sometimes just a _bit_ better than the movie.

previousepisode.name: Toni Morrison's Opus About Confronting a Terrible Past

name: Insectarium
summary: Entomologist and museum curator Jessica Ware will introduce us to insects that upend our expectations and a diverse group of scientists who are passionate about the six-legged critters all around us. Forget about pandas–we're here to make you fall in love with mandibles! The series is produced for PBS by the American Museum of Natural History.

previousepisode.name: How Mantises Became Nature's Strangest Assassins

name: Infinite Series
summary: Mathematician Kelsey Houston-Edwards offers ambitious content for viewers that are eager to attain a greater understanding of the world around them. Math is pervasive - a robust yet precise language - and with each episode you'll begin to see the math that underpins everything in this puzzling, yet fascinating, universe.

name: Код кохання
summary: Investigator Veronika Levchenko is forced to cooperate with the talented cybercriminal Andriy Miroshnyk in order to save her younger brother. Veronika and Andrii fall in love with each other, but realize that they cannot be together. Can their love overcome the boundaries of duty and danger?

name: Sovereign Innovations
summary: Discover how Indigenous innovation and technology allows Indigenous communities to survive and thrive now and across the centuries. Our host, Cheyenne Bearfoot, will explore various native and Indigenous identities across the globe in order to unravel stereotypes that have diminished innovations made by Indigenous peoples.

previousepisode.name: How Indigenous Knowledge Connects to Science

name: The Crusaders
summary: Discovering the real stories of the medieval knights who dedicated their entire lives to God, the Crusaders, to delve deeper into the history behind the popular image of heroic, chivalrous knights.

name: Wild Crusades
summary: Sri Lanka is one of the most bio-diverse places on the planet but it's also home to one of the world's fastest-growing human populations. Animals and humans come into increasing contact and the results can be catastrophic. In this three part series we meet the scientists and researchers who are dedicating their lives to ensuring that Sri Lanka's most extraordinary wildlife – elephants, monkeys and sloth bears – can share this tiny island with people in peace.

name: Serving Up Science
summary: Serving Up Science is hosted by history buff, science writer and foodie Sheril Kirshenbaum, who will give you science-backed tips to make your favorite foods even better. Farmed or Wild? Why does cheese stink? Why should meat rest? Explore these questions and more.

previousepisode.name: Why Cast Iron Skillets Last Forever (And How to Use Them Right!)

name: Liao Zhai
summary: In the bustling streets and among the common folk, strange and eerie phenomena arise. Humans, demons, deities, and spirits all understand the ways of the world, while flowers, trees, birds, and beasts are all imbued with a certain spirit. Humans have a touch of the demonic, and demons possess a human heart. This revival of classic Eastern supernatural tales, with a volume of "Liao Zhai," discerns the good and evil between yin and yang, and paints a vivid picture of the myriad aspects of life.

name: Tycoons - Die Macht der Milliardäre
summary: The series shows the richest people in the world who have great influence in their countries: In China and Russia they live dangerously, in the USA they are changing the modern world with innovations.

name: The Sixty Million Dollar Conman
summary: Hamish McLaren scammed friends, lovers and acquaintances out of over $60 million. This is the shocking story of Australia's most successful con artist. Part of True Crime on Channel 4.

name: Welt der Ritter
summary: A fierce warrior-class emerges in medieval Europe around 1000 years ago: the knights. They live brutal lives, glorified by tales of chivalry and courtly love that have left us with a skewed idea of knighthood. In reality, it's a world of freezing castles and violent battles, where joust competitions, fair maidens and the crusades are the latest fads. Manners and gallantry are everything and their abuse can end in deadly duels. This elegant and exciting 3-part series evokes the time of the knights in a unique and intimate rollercoaster ride of individual lives set in the wider context of medieval Europe. Their stories are told in gripping reenactments, illustrated by stunning CGI and explored with engaging documentary sequences.

name: Secrets of the Royal Traditions
summary: Revealing how the monarchy uses traditions to maintain a place in our nation's identity.

name: Bob Vila's Home Again
summary: Building contractor and all-around handyman Bob Vila visits the sites of various home and commercial building construction and restorations, and gives viewers tips on the best way to finish such projects.

name: Снежный папа
summary: An ordinary hairdresser Irina, having separated from her husband, is raising her daughter Masha alone. Unexpectedly, fate gives Irina a gift: meeting a successful businessman Oleg Tsarev. Trying to please him, Irina comes up with a new successful life for herself, in which she is the owner of an elite beauty salon, and her daughter is a student at a private school. Irina and Oleg's relationship is moving towards the registry office, but suddenly her husband Kolya, whom she has not officially divorced, appears on the threshold of Irina's apartment. Kolya is determined to get his family and Irina's love back.

name: A Celebration of Sean O'Casey
summary: A series dedicated to the centenary of Irish writer Sean O'Casey consisting of a documentary on his life followed by three dramatisations of his plays.

name: La Promesa
summary: Lured by promises of a better life, three young women are sold into prostitution and must risk their lives and their families to escape.

name: La Bruja
summary: This is the story of two characters, a witch and a known mafia boss, who strongly influence Colombia's political destiny at the end of the 1970s, changing the entire future of the country.

name: Çift Kişilik Oda
summary: Having lost her parents at a young age, Nilüfer's dream is to work at the Lutesya Hotel, which her parents built. Kaan, one of the heirs of the hotel, returns to the hotel, which has been ruled by his step-sister Sevil for years, to take revenge. Nothing will ever be the same for Nilüfer and Kaan, whose paths cross here.

name: Lian Dan Wo Bu Hui, Zuo Cai Suan Bu Suan
The Channel Islands At War
summary: Written, produced and presented by John Nettles, this 3 part documentary coinciding with the 70th anniversary of the German invasion and occupation of the Channel Islands, the only part of the UK conquered by the Germans in the Second World War.

name: When The Hawthorn Blooms
summary: In the early 1970s, Jing Qiu, a girl from a "politically problematic" family, is sent to the countryside for re-education. While documenting village history in Xicunping, she meets the talented and handsome Lao San. Their budding affection faces harsh trials: class stigma, family opposition, and the rigid social hierarchy. Can their promise to reunite under the hawthorn tree ever bloom true?

name: De glemte piger
summary: In 1979, four-year-old Heidi disappears without a trace in Kolding. Heidi has never been found and police are still at large in the case. The year before, 13-year-old Line was abducted in Lyngby. Police find her killed after three weeks. Both the abduction of Heidi and the murder of Line are unsolved, but the cases must never be forgotten. In both cases, we are pursuing the search to find important witnesses who can bring new information about both cases. We have gained access to the Travel Team's confidential journal of Heidi's case, and former Travel Team Manager Hans Jørgen Bonnichsen and several other police officers and witnesses stand up and tell about clues and important turning points in the case - clues that lead all the way to today with new angles and new knowledge about 'The Forgotten Girls'.

name: Franklin
summary: A counterfeit artist, also a single father, is forced to work with his ex-lover to craft the perfect $100 bill — all to save his dying daughter.

name: The Killer Within
summary: Delve into what turns someone into a killer. Whether it was premeditated or spontaneous, a revenge plot or the killer simply snapped, experts uncover the true story behind each killer from the very beginning.

name: The ChuckleHounds
summary: The Chuckle Brothers dressed as giant hounds get into all sorts of adventures and scrapes in this programme aimed at pre-school children.

name: Тюремный дневник
summary: Russian student Maria Butina unwittingly gets caught in a dangerous political game during her U.S. studies. Arrested, she faces isolation, pressure and interrogation, forcing her to choose between self-interest and loyalty to her homeland.

name: Stillwater
summary: Stillwater follows ex-convict Daniel West, who receives a mysterious letter promising answers about his past and a substantial inheritance in the small town of Stillwater. There he discovers a community where nothing ever ages, no one dies and nobody ever gets out.

name: Vaka
summary: Vaka centers on the survival of Stockholm's population when an epidemic of insomnia sweeps the city, turning everyone's lives into a waking nightmare of chaos. As the disease spreads, fates and lives collide against an unstoppable threat. While a disgraced prime minister battles to control the city and his image while protecting his reckless son, a dedicated ambulance nurse risks everything to save her infected lover, and a teenage girl defends a young neighbor after his family falls victim to illness and conspiracies.

name: Встать на ноги
summary:
A former prisoner named Stary returns to his hometown after 20 years in prison and finds out that he has a daughter, Olya, with limited mobility. In addition, the Old One still has one important unfinished business from 20 years ago. His former accomplice Rakhimov is at large, for whom the Old One just sat down, taking all the blame on himself. Meanwhile, Rakhimov rose decently with the help of the looted money and completely forgot about the existence of his former friend. The district police officer prescribes that the Old man, who is under the supervision of the authorities, must live together with his own daughter.

In an attempt to establish a relationship with Olya, the "daddy" persistently begins to help her, but the daughter is not enthusiastic about her newfound father and tries to get rid of a suddenly revealed relative. But gradually she manages to see something human in his actions, a trusting relationship is built between them and both realize that it is the Old One who needs real help and support.

name: Речная сказка
summary: Cosmetologist Alina Svetlova comes to a sanatorium outside the city to recover from a prolonged bout of bronchitis. And immediately finds herself a suspect in the murder of her ex, Dmitry. Trying to hide the evidence, she crosses paths with former detective Mikhail. Alina must solve the murder case and decide whether to trust Mikhail. He helps her, but he seems to have his own interests…

name: Mission to the Moon
summary: A person dies twice in life. The first is when their body perishes, and the second is when they fade from the memory of others.

name: Suspicious Partner
summary: Tateishi Haruto, a skilled prosecutor, is mistaken for a molester by Miyashita Sakura on the bus and has a terrible experience. After that, he happens to encounter Sakura, who is fighting after her boyfriend cheated on her, and ends up helping her without thinking... This leads to Haruto having to join Sakura in her drowning binge, and she pushes him down when he's completely drunk! A few days later, Haruto is reunited with Sakura, who has come to take her prosecutor training. Haruto is strict with Sakura, but for some reason he can't leave her alone.

name: Dead-End Job
summary: Dead-End Job follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.

name: Virgins
summary: Virgins a wild, warm, and wonderfully awkward ride with four adults who have yet to experience sexual intercourse, as they navigate love, intimacy, and self-discovery in their 30s and 40s.After years of missed connections and dating horror stories, these late bloomers are done playing it safe. They're stepping outside their comfort zones and taking big swings to finally go all the way, emotionally and physically. From navigating awkward first dates to exploring a bondage class and working with an intimacy partner they're putting it all on the line in hopes of finally sealing the deal.

name: Kill Lover
summary: Youyou was born into a wealthy and loving family, but at the age of ten, tragedy struck—her mother fell to her death, and her father was imprisoned. Ten years later, Youyou discovered that it was An Guoxuan who had orchestrated it all. In a moment of rage, she sought revenge but failed, and accidentally blinded An Guoxuan's son, Qi Dong. In retaliation, Qi Dong heartlessly threw her into the sea. Miraculously, Youyou was rescued by Madam Yu from the Yuan Bi Orphanage and sent abroad. Qi Dong, as An Guoxuan's illegitimate child, was never truly favored. After losing his sight, he was completely cast aside. Yet with sheer determination, he trained himself to function like any other person and eventually founded his own company to rival An Guoxuan's Xingyao Group. Five years later, Youyou returns in glory under the alias "Qi Gege," now a top architectural designer. Major companies compete to recruit her—including Qi Dong's. She pretends to work with him, planning to use him as a stepping stone for revenge. But as they navigate their tangled pasts, Youyou begins to realize that Qi Dong's goal isn't to inherit Xingyao Group. In fact, his mother died because of An Guoxuan too, and he returned to the An family for the same reason as her—revenge. The two finally drop their masks and join forces to take An Guoxuan down. But lurking in the shadows, an even more formidable enemy has begun to make their move…

name: Relative Secrets
summary: Relative Secrets investigate an everyday American family's darkest mystery, aiming both to solve the mystery and explore how it shapes that family today. Colorful characters, rich cultural context and dramatic twists and turns abound in every tale, each of which connects the American family to their UK heritage. Along the way, we'll meet charismatic heroes and terrifying villains, ranging from a 99-year-old World War II veteran who worries his absence led to the murder of his grandmother, to the daughter of a serial killer desperate to carve out her own identity from her father's sordid past to a mother who abandoned her three children to start a new secret life.

name: Murder Has Two Faces
summary: In the shadow of a highly publicized tragedy, an eerily similar crime is overlooked. GMA's Robin Roberts shines new light on the victims largely ignored.

name: Call Her Alex
summary: What does it take to become the most influential female podcaster of a generation? Following Alex Cooper as she prepares for her first tour, this compelling two-part documentary series traces Cooper's evolution—from a self-conscious kid growing up in Pennsylvania to the voice behind "Call Her Daddy," a podcast that redefined the conversation for women everywhere. The series offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at the life-defining events that shaped Cooper's journey as she grew from a 24-year-old woman with a sex and dating podcast to the CEO of a media empire in just six years. More than just a success story, it's a portrait of a woman who is creating a space where women feel seen, heard, and empowered.

name: Cheat: Unfinished Business
summary: Sun, scandal and second chances collide in this reality show in which former cheaters reconnect with their exes. With Amanda Holden and Paul C. Brunson.

name: Round and Round
summary: High-concept relationship sitcom with each episode charting a different key year in the life of Maureen Stevens, over a 14-year time span.

name: BLK: An Origin Story
summary: BLK: An Origin Story acts as an immersive and informative chapter of Black Canadian history, elevating remarkable Black Canadians previously unacknowledged in mainstream social, academic, and cultural circles, normalizing their unique stories as a matter of general record.

name: Dun Huang, antigua fortaleza de la frontera
summary: This series reveals how the Chinese fortress city of Dun Huang moved from an oasis in the desert to a vital commercial bastion.

name: Mad Unicorn
summary: Santi has struggled to survive since childhood. Now, he risks everything to take his startup business to the big leagues. Inspired by true events.

name: Natalie Cassidy: Caring Together
summary:
Best known for playing Sonia Fowler on EastEnders, Natalie Cassidy will be taking on a new role – but off-screen, fulfilling her genuine ambition of a lifetime to train as a carer. She will study, work and care alongside the next generation of young carers.

Natalie will be enrolling at one of the UK's top Health & Social Care colleges where she'll train, study, and work alongside real professionals - facing the realities, the heartbreak, and the joy of caring. Together, her and her fellow students will push open the door to the UK's healthcare providers and put the spotlight on something we all face at some point in our lives - who will care for our parents, who will care for our children... and who will care for us?

Will Natalie and her classmates have what it takes to be the next generation of healthcare heroes?

name: Earnhardt
summary: Earnhardt will dive into the rich history of Dale Earnhardt, one of the sport's most influential figures to ever compete at NASCAR's highest level. Through rare archival footage, thrilling races and emotional interviews from his children, colleagues and closest friends, the docuseries will depict Dale Earnhardt's rise to NASCAR stardom and nationwide fame. Earnhardt's navigation of family dynamics — including that of his son, Dale Earnhardt. Jr. — will also be explored.

name: Perdiendo el juicio
summary: Prestigious lawyer Amanda suffers a severe OCD breakdown during a high-stakes trial.

name: The Way Out
summary: In this escape room comedy show, two teams – Team "Content Creators" and Team "Comedians" – compete against each other, trying to be the first to find their way out of cleverly designed adventure rooms. In each episode, a duo from each team faces off in identically themed settings, where they must prove themselves. Climbing, crawling, swimming – and using their brains – are all part of the challenge. Julien Bam and Joon Kim provide commentary from off-screen.

previousepisode.name: Ju, wir haben die Finalisten geschrumpft!

name: Gram Chikitsalay
summary: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.

name: The Secret Headliner
summary:
In each episode, one of Ireland's biggest musical acts will offer the opportunity of a lifetime to an up-and-coming artist – a chance to share the stage as their Support Act. As the Secret Headliner returns to their roots to play a secret gig in a small venue that was central to their journey to success, they have the chance to "give back" by offering support and mentorship to an emerging act who dares to dream.

Each episode features the origin story of the Secret Headliner, charting their rise from small venues to hit albums, diamond status streaming, and sold-out arenas and international tours.

Hundreds of emerging artists provide a demo song or short set on video for consideration. The Secret Headliner selects their pick and delivers this exciting news personally to their chosen Support Act. The Support Act is now one of the very few people who know the identity of the Secret Headliner.

The Secret Headliner selects the venue, a small space that was central to their journey to stardom – it might be the venue where a particular gig led to their record deal, or where they had their first ticketed show – where only 50 people turned up … and half of them were family and friends!

Everything then builds to the Secret Headliner gig. The Support Act hones their set, reacts to this huge opportunity, and talks of their hopes and dreams. The identity of the established artist remains a secret to the attending audience until they walk on stage at the Secret Headliner gig. Meanwhile, the event publicist gets the Support Act in front of the press to help raise their profile, build a buzz, and drive an audience for the big show. The tension builds as the Support Act's nerves kick in. The audience begins to queue outside, as soundchecks are completed. Doors open and it's showtime - the biggest gig for the Support Act, a return to the most intimate of performances for The Secret Headliner.

The Secret Headliners include Picture This, Cian Ducrot and Belters Only, with the Support Acts being: Simple Things from Kerry, Paddy Keyes from Sligo, and Groveline from Leitrim.

name: Eltons 12
summary: New competition show in which twelve celebrity candidates compete in each programme, all of whom have something special in common, e.g. a TV format, a profession or a passion. Although they are united as a group, they will duel one-to-one in two rounds. In the final, the three best will compete against each other, with the winner receiving prize money totalling 100,000 euros. Elton presents the programme, with Frank Buschmann on the commentary microphone.

name: Raabs Pokernacht mit GGPoker.de
summary: It's time to gamble again - and for real money! Stefan Raab welcomes Elton and three other celebrity players to the card table. And you also have the chance to gamble as a wildcard winner in qualifying tournaments. We reveal how it works.

name: Drei gegen Einen - Die Show der Champions
summary: In this show, Elton, Jens "Knossi" Knossalla and Tim Mälzer compete as a team against real champions: Olympic champions, world champions and world record holders - the celebrities would hardly stand a chance in a one-on-one duel, but as a trio they want to rise to the challenge. Elton, Knossi and Tim Mälzer have to assert themselves against a total of ten champions. The prize for each edition is 50,000 euros. Laura Wontorra will host the new show.

name: Licht Aus
summary: Eight celebrities try to survive 120 hours without light.

name: Pat Krimson: Bigger and Bolder
summary: At sixty, Pat Krimson looks back on his career. He speaks frankly about the successes and setbacks. About love, friendships, and feuds. About the straight... and the crooked path.

previousepisode.name: From heaven to hell and back

name: De Vuurwerkramp
summary: What started as a sunny day 25 years ago ended in a devastating disaster. A huge explosion wiped out an entire city district.

name: Tool Academy
summary: Twelve men think they're taking part in a reality show that hopes to find the "ultimate lad". In fact, their girlfriend's have nominated them for Tool Academy, where they'll be transformed from lazy boyfriends to the perfect partner - or so they think...

name: Kun Tun Tianxia Zhi Zhang Men Guilai
summary: Fan Lingxiao, a spiritual pet master with exceptional talents, was plotted against during the Level-A sect promotion competition and was devoured by Kun, his own spiritual pet. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named "Liu Fengmang" and was imprisoned in the White Mansion's dungeon. Meanwhile, his own sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was in a perilous state. To uncover the truth of being devoured by Kun and revitalize his sect, Fan Lingxiao, accompanied by his existing spiritual pets, embarked on a brand-new adventure journey with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

name: ONE: High School Heroes
summary: A school action drama that depicts the story of a model student who once dedicated all his attention to studying but finds himself entangled in domestic violence and school bullying, compelling him to make a transformative decision. "High School Heroes" pertains to a group formed by the main characters who stand up against school violence perpetrators on behalf of the victims.

name: A Head Coach's Turnover
summary:
Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team ‘Big Pandas', which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae' coaching a professional basketball team.

Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname ‘Maeng Gong Extermination Group'. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong.

With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.

name: The Hunter With a Scalpel
summary: Seo Se-Hyun is a genius forensic pathologist. While examining a corpse, she discovers traces of her father Yoon Jo-Kyun who is a serial killer. She desperately attempts to track down her father Yoon Jo-Kyun with Jung Jung-Hyun. He is the chief of the violent crimes team.

name: Mating Season
summary: Mating Season is set in the animal world starring a cast of bears, raccoons, deer, foxes and a host of other horny, lovable forest critters, as they navigate love, sexual relationships and the universal need to hook up and find a partner.

name: Gâtées pourries
summary: Kim, Frédérique et Justine, amies inséparables aux névroses assumées, approchent la mi-trentaine sans parvenir à surmonter leurs insatisfactions. Kim rêve d'amour stable, Fred lutte contre l'anxieté, and Justine déteste son emploi. Leur amitié leur sert de refuge face aux échecs et aux menaces du passé. May this soutien mutuel trop récomfortant les empêche-t-il d'avancer?

name: Jonge Garde
summary: "Jonge Garde" is about six students attending an exclusive culinary and hospitality academy. Here they are prepared for a successful life in the smartest restaurants. But in order to achieve this, they have to work hard and overcome challenges. You do not become a good chef overnight...

name: Bad Boy
summary: A comedian recounts how his wit kept him alive inside a brutal juvenile detention center in this raw, coming-of-age drama inspired by true events.

name: Malditos
summary: Facing expulsion from their land, a matriarch of a traveling community and her sons fight to save their clan while hiding a dark family secret that could destroy them.

name: Yolanthe
summary: Join Yolanthe Cabau on an emotional journey of highs and lows as she leaves the Dutch capital for a fresh start in LA with her 8-year-old son.

previousepisode.name: Één voor allen, allen voor één

name: Polartag/Polarnacht
summary: In Europe, there is no other place where contrasts and contradictions lie so close to one another as in the region north of the Polar Circle. Brilliant colours, abundant food and hectic activity in the animal world during the polar day form a stark contrast to the soft, muted colours, struggle for survival and icy cold of the polar night. A race against time begins, as the long hours of the bright polar day are as interminable as those of the dark polar night. Both extremes are immensely challenging for both flora and fauna in this landscape – but nature has an answer for everything.

name: Global Soul Kitchen
summary: Best-selling author and chef Deborah VanTrece introduces viewers to "global soul food," a style of cooking that combines traditional Southern American soul food with different international influences to create something both familiar and new. Her dishes run the worldwide gamut from smothered chicken meatballs over herb truffled spaetzle to paella macaroni.

name: Andrew Zimmern's Field to Fire
summary: In Field to Fire, lifelong outdoorsman and chef Andrew Zimmern heads back into the field to source his favorite proteins. From wild pigs in South Carolina to redhead duck in Texas, culinary icon Andrew Zimmern is geared up to hunt, fish, and harvest everything our country has to offer. After the catch, Andrew will demystify cooking wild food over an open fire while sharing tips for creating the ultimate wild game meal.

name: Bansan Blues
summary: Takubo Yuta works as a drama director at a TV station and has achieved his dream, but he is very busy with work. His former passion has disappeared, and he is living an unstable life, getting irritated all the time. Meanwhile, Sato Kosuke, who was supposed to be doing well as a chef, quietly quit his job and is now living a NEET life. The two meet again when their old friend from high school, Makita Aoi, gets divorced. Then, after a certain incident, they start to just eat dinner together. Through these "dinner activities" (bankatsu), Yuta and Kosuke recover their hearts and get back to their true selves.

name: Black, White & Gray - Love Kills
summary: Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.

name: Нюрнбергская история
summary: 1945. In Nuremberg, the International Tribunal prepares to sentence the German invaders and their accomplices. Igor Volgin, a former frontline intelligence officer, serves as a translator for the Soviet delegation. In the city, Volgin meets Lena, a woman who was forced to work in Germany during the war. While Igor and Lena gradually fall in love, the trial is in jeopardy. The Soviet delegation desperately tries to stop the spies and traitors who are obstructing justice.

name: American Prince: JFK Jr.
summary: The remarkable life and enduring legacy of John F. Kennedy Jr. are explored in this three-part CNN Original Series. American Prince: JFK Jr. traces his early years marked by his father's assassination and the societal and familial pressures to carry the Kennedy torch, through his decision to create George, a new kind of political magazine within the rapidly evolving media landscape of the 90s. It also reveals the love story he shared with Carolyn Bessette, which was relentlessly targeted by media attention. From his charmed early years to his untimely death, this is the untold story of one of America's most iconic and beloved figures.

name: Live Aid at 40: When Rock 'n' Roll Took on the World
summary: A look at the legacy of Band Aid, Live Aid and Live 8 in reshaping global charity and politics. Featuring interviews with Bob Geldof, Bono, Sting, and African and western leaders of the time.

name: Billionaire Boys Club
summary: In the greed-fueled landscape of 1980s Los Angeles, a group of young, ambitious men set out to make their fortune—but their lavish dreams quickly spiral into a web of deception, fraud, and murder. Produced by Universal Television Alternative Studio (UTAS), Billionaire Boys Club unpacks the rise and fall of Joe Hunt and the exclusive investment group comprised of privileged 20-somethings whose schemes and crimes led to murder and captivated the media. In an era where fraud and deception have become status quo, Billionaire Boys Club serves as a chilling cautionary tale—revealing what happens when ambition becomes obsession, and a mansion-sized empire is nothing more than a house of cards waiting to collapse.

name: The Real Eddy English
summary: Four-part thriller set in Oxford, but not the University, in which young Eddy English tries to find out why someone killed his uncle Big Eddy.

name: Maneet's Eats
summary: Chef Maneet Chauhan walks you through her favorite recipes for all the most craveable Indian dishes, from shopping for ingredients at a local Indian market to serving up dishes in a traditional style.

name: Formula E: Driver
summary:
Formula E: Driver is a high-stakes, four-part series following the journeys of four of the sport's biggest personalities: António Félix da Costa, Mitch Evans, Jake Dennis and Dan Ticktum, as they navigate the challenges and victories across Season 10 of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship.

Each episode offers viewers a never-before-seen look into the lives of some of the Championship's most prominent figures.

name: Europe's Amazon
summary: Discover the secret Drava Delta: a stunning, diverse wetland teeming with life, where icy alpine rivers meet lush lowland habitats in an untouched European gem.

name: Bob Monkhouse On the Spot
summary: Bob Monkhouse faces members of the public in a unique, no-holds-barred question and answer session.

name: Diário de Pilar
summary: Pilar is a girl who loves traveling and dreams about knowing all the countries in the world.

name: O País do Cinema
summary: Andréia Horta leads a dive into the history of Brazilian cinema. The actress welcomes filmmakers, directors and performers to discuss their works.

name: Daqui Houve Resistência
summary: Anti-fascist resistance and struggle, centered in the north of Portugal, during the 13 years leading up to April 25, 1974.

name: Making of: The Last of Us
summary: Featuring extensive interviews with the cast and crew, this all-access documentary gives a rare glimpse into the daunting behind-the-scenes efforts that went into the production of the HBO Original smash hit series The Last of Us.

name: Aşkı Hatırla
summary: The renowned architect Deniz and popular editor Güneş, who, on the verge of marriage, experience breakups in their respective lives. However, their lives take a transformative turn when, on the same evening, they cross paths by chance, a message on their phones sets them on a journey that will change everything. This new adventure leads them to uncover the missing pieces in their relationship and rediscover love.

name: Blood on the Bridge
summary: As tensions erupt between British troops and American colonists, revolution takes root in the actions of bold individuals. Samuel Adams pushes resistance into rebellion, Paul Revere rides to warn the militias, and George Washington prepares to lead a war no one planned for. From political intrigue to battlefield defiance, these men shape the opening shots of the American Revolution and the birth of a nation.

name: I Have A Little Story
summary: Short Series I Have A Little Story is a series of love stories.

name: Airport Security: Rome
summary: At Rome's Fiumicino Airport, security personnel work around the clock to keep Italy's busiest airport free of criminal activity. Italian State Police tackle drug trafficking and illegal immigration at this gateway to Italy and the European Union. And a crack security team remain alert for signs of thieves in the airport's expansive shopping areas. Illegal drugs, fake passports and purloined perfume: it's all in a day's work at Fiumicino.

name: Seal My Lips With a Kiss
Giants
summary: Circle the globe on this exhilarating 5-part epic that "connects the dots" between the GIANTS of the natural world, past and present.

name: The Cop And The Kid
summary: A judge awards custody of a foster home-runaway black kid to Frank Murphy, a fat, middle-aged white bachelor cop. Lucas, the kid. is engagingly portrayed by a youngster named Tierre Turner. The policeman and the kid meet when the cop almost runs over the smart-mouthed youngster, and meet a second time when, after the kid steals a radio, the cop chases him and collapses with an asthma attack. The kid stays to help him and is collared. When they appear in court, the kid uses the cop's asthma for blackmail, forcing a leniency plea on his behalf — or else he will have the cop bounced from the force. Murphy makes so moving a plea for mercy that the court makes him the guardian of the kid — and his flea-bitten mutt.

name: Passport to Love
summary: The series revolves around the idea of finding love through travel, with each movie exploring a different destination and its unique charm.

name: Solo para mujeres
summary: A four-part documentary series created in collaboration with the founders of Solo para mujeres and a team of filmmakers and historians with extensive experience. Solo para mujeres will serve as a lens through which to observe some of the processes that have shaped Mexico today: the change in social roles, the liberation of women, the opening of democracy, the conquest of the public sphere by civil society, the emergence of new television stars, the pluralization of desires.

name: Swingers: How To Win An Election
summary: Swing and soft voters decide elections, and there are more of them than ever. Casey Briggs charts how the tectonic plates of Australian politics are shifting and what it means for who wins the Federal Election in 2025.

name: El principe del barrio
summary: Albertano may leave the neighborhood, but the neighborhood will never leave him. Now that he is an independent man, he decides to move to Lomas de Chacaltepec, a magical town where his peculiar way of being will get himinto fun troubles.

name: Look Who's Hangry
summary: Chef Daniel Lambert is cooking up some 'emotional food' as he pits two creators against each other in a battle of bizarre food mashups and culinary chaos.

name: Mengele Unveiled
summary: Using unpublished documents, expert reports and survivor testimonies, we examine Josef Mengele's legacy and question whether he was a war criminal or solely a scapegoat for the horrors of Nazism.

name: Bad Nanny
summary:
Bad Nanny tells the story of Samantha Cookes who, for over a decade across Ireland and the UK, used a revolving door of aliases including Carrie Jade Williams and Sadie Harris to weave an intricate web of lies, deceiving everyone from vulnerable families to online communities. Her story was the subject of RTÉ podcast series The Real Carrie Jade.  

With gripping first-hand accounts, chilling insight into psychological manipulation, shocking revelations, and raw emotion, the TV documentary series is a must-watch exposé on one woman's decade-long con and the strength of those who brought her down. It features exclusive interviews with victims of Samantha's scams who have never spoken publicly and includes unseen archive footage of Samantha.

name: Uncharted with Ray Goggins
summary:
A new RTÉ series sees adventurer and former special forces soldier Ray Goggins take well-known Irish faces from the worlds of politics, music and sport on extreme outdoor expeditions through some of the most remote and treacherous environments on Earth, pushing each participant far beyond their comfort zone in the ultimate test of survival and resilience.

Each week, Ray challenges a new well-known pairing with a physically and mentally demanding adventure, designed to push each participant to their limits. As they face the wild together, the experience becomes more than just an adrenaline rush — it's a deeply emotional journey. Bonds are forged, stories shared, and vulnerabilities surface, as Ray guides participants through a transformative wilderness challenge. Will these experiences reveal something new to the viewer about these well-known personalities?

name: Iolo's River Valleys
summary: Iolo Williams explores four of Wales's most stunning river valleys from sea to source, uncovering their hidden wonders and remarkable wildlife.

name: Horrible Science
summary: Hilarious new characters, mind-boggling science facts, and Sir Isaac Newton on terrifying rollercoasters... science is about to get very horrible indeed!

previousepisode.name: Manky Materials and Shifty States Special

name: Holiday Home Makeover with Rachel and Ryan
summary:
With three young children in tow, Rachel and Ryan throw caution to the wind, set themselves a gruelling renovation schedule and embark on the challenge of transforming a tired, sprawling property on the stunning South Coast of New South Wales into their dream holiday home.

This has been a lifelong ambition for the power couple, building a breathtaking coastal escape for their family and others to relax, unwind and enjoy a home away from home.

name: Gu Wei Nan Ting
summary: The chatty teenager Gao Ying, who is solely focused on getting into Guangmei University, accidentally stumbles into a Qing Dynasty hotel in Nanting Village and becomes entangled in a mysterious conflict of a century-long catastrophe. The ancient criminal, Prince Yinti of the Qing Dynasty, who has guarded a secret for three hundred years, finally meets this chosen one who will seal the "Taisui" completely. Is it a coincidence, or has fate already arranged for their encounter?

name: Séamus Goes Wild
summary: Seamus Goes Wild is an engaging new children's series bringing little ones on a fascinating journey into the world of Irish natural history. Seamus Goes Wild follows the adventures of Seamus the farm dog as he explores the rivers, coasts, fields and forests of the west of Ireland.

name: Legacy
summary: New four-part series on Ireland's National Historic properties.

name: Too Hot to Handle: Italia
summary: A group of flirty singles mixes in paradise, but to win the cash prize, there's a catch: no sex. Will they resist temptation or let desire take over?

name: Mark Moriarty: Cook Like a Chef
summary: In Cook Like a Chef, award-winning chef Mark Moriarty invites viewers to rethink the way they cook at home

name: Løgnen
summary: After their home-care team leader's death, two assistants-new hire Sille and veteran Rie-uncover dangerous secrets and power dynamics that could destroy their careers and expose the system's dark side.

name: The Wayfinders
summary: When three high schoolers are mysteriously transported to a fantasy world, they find themselves caught in a battle for survival. With magic, monsters, and unexpected allies—including a fierce princess and a teenage werebear—the teens must navigate this strange new land. As they search for a way home, they discover hidden strengths and face challenges that will test their courage like never before.

name: Serpientes y escaleras
summary: An ambitious but overlooked teacher wants to be head of a prestigious school, but must climb a slippery ladder of lies and corruption to reach the top.

name: The Saturday Game
summary: Highlights and analysis of the day's Championship action.

name: Kings Court
summary: Kings Court is a new dating series with three celebrity kings — supermodel Tyson Beckford, NBA All-Star Carlos Boozer and WWE legend Thaddeus "Titus O'Neil" Bullard — searching for their queen among 21 smart, accomplished and beautiful single ladies ready to risk it all for the one.

name: Honestly Cavallari: The Headline Tour
summary: Honestly Cavallari: The Headline Tour follows TV personality Kristin Cavallari as she takes her hit podcast "Let's Be Honest" on the road. Each episode of the series will feature candid conversations with famous friends, Bravolebrities, memorable exes and other notable celebs from Kristin's life as they unfold the stories behind their buzziest headlines – and make new ones – with jaw-dropping revelations that set the record straight.  With stops in Atlanta, Chicago, Boston and New York, the series also follows Kristin and BFF Justin Anderson off the stage as they explore local hot spots in each city with friends and podcast guests.

name: Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas
summary: Five friends, Rasheda, Geneva, Naomi, Tiffany and Bridgette, support each other through divorce, marriage, dating, healing and friendship struggles while their loyalty and sisterhood bonds are tested.

name: Caught in the Act: Double Life
summary: Caught in the Act: Double Life delivers the high-stakes investigations, juicy reveals and emotional confrontations fans expect, now with a fresh focus on exposing secret lives across various relationships.

previousepisode.name: Let Me Tell You Some Street 101

name: Burden of Proof: The Case Against Diddy
summary: Burden of Proof: The Case Against Diddy will be an in-depth look into the high-profile federal trial of the music mogul. The series will deliver real-time updates and analysis of the defense and prosecution as Combs faces federal charges, including racketeering and sex trafficking, to which he has pleaded not guilty.

name: Von Fock
summary: Newly appointed court assessor Paul von Fock, heir to Sagadi Manor, navigates a web of murders, missing fortunes, and identity puzzles with the aid of the mysterious Maria von Nottbeck, whom he helps unmask in a shocking finale.

name: POV:
summary: Norway's biggest TikTokers live for a week in a luxury villa in Spain. There will be drama, humor and a lot of content! <3

name: Pro Bono
summary: The story of Kang Da Wit, a successful judge with exceptional work efficiency and quick thinking, but he is also materialistic and obsessed with success. One day, he faces an unexpected crisis and, against his will, becomes a public defender.

name: Vermelho Sangue
summary: A story filled with suspense, fantasy, and romance set in the city of Guarambá, the sanctuary of the maned wolf, where the paths of Luna, the wolf-girl, cross with those of Flora, a human, under the watchful eyes of the vampires Michel and Celina. As they face their personal dilemmas, they will discover both their similarities and their differences.
